items.title: CropGuardNet: A Unified Lightweight CNN-Transformer Framework with Multi-Scale Attention and Explainable AI for Cross-Crop Leaf Disease Detection
items.venue: Manuscript Under Peer Review
items.tldr: A 481,574-parameter (1.84 MB, 5.00 ms CPU ONNX) conditioned CNN-Transformer evaluated on 35,420 UUID- and pHash-deduplicated leaf images across 8 crops and 38 classes (99.17% accuracy, 0.9874 F1-macro), purging 80,238 duplicates and auditing four XAI families.

items.title: Capture-session confounding undermines the measurement validity of deep learning clove grading: evidence from Zanzibar
items.venue: Manuscript Under Peer Review
items.tldr: Shows that 16 of 17 neural networks reach 98.1% to 99.3% in-session test macro-F1 on clove grading yet collapse to 29% to 47% on unseen acquisition days, still scoring 98.5% on empty backgrounds with cloves inpainted away.

items.title: AI-Powered Surveillance, Internet Shutdowns, and Digital Citizenship as Resistance in East Africa: Evidence from Tanzania and Kenya
items.shortTitle: AI Surveillance & Digital Citizenship in EA
items.venue: Manuscript Under Peer Review
items.tldr: Comparative political-economy and governance analysis of AI surveillance, internet shutdowns, and Ubuntu/Afrofeminist digital citizenship resistance across Tanzania and Kenya between 2015 and 2025.

items.title: Launched, Celebrated, Forgotten: A Critical Review of Why Digital and AI-Enabled Agriculture Platforms Fail, Stall, or Survive in East Africa
items.shortTitle: Why Digital Ag Platforms Fail or Survive in EA
items.venue: Manuscript Under Peer Review
items.tldr: Audits 22 named digital and AI agriculture platforms across five East African countries (2009-2026), revealing only 1 of 10 standalone startups sustains active scale compared with 12 of 12 institutionally embedded platforms.

items.title: Between Promise and Practice: Institutional Drivers and Barriers to Digital Transformation in Sub-Saharan African Smallholder Agriculture
items.shortTitle: Institutional Barriers in SSA Digital Ag
items.venue: Manuscript Under Peer Review
items.tldr: Synthesizes Technology-Organization-Environment (TOE) and institutional voids evidence across Kenya, Tanzania, and Ethiopia showing why isolated digital tools falter despite 25% conditional yield gains.

items.title: DGS-Bench: Measuring the Deployment Gap in African Agricultural AI Requires Balanced Metrics: A Cassava Case Study
items.venue: Deep Learning Indaba 2026, Pan-Atlantic University, Lagos, Nigeria
items.award: Best Poster Award, Deep Learning Indaba 2026 (Lagos, Nigeria)
items.tldr: Demonstrates that aggregate accuracy hides catastrophic minority-disease failures under field shift in African cassava diagnostics, introducing balanced deployment-gap evaluation metrics, closed-form mirage onset analysis, and v1.1 calibration/Grad-CAM extensions (Best Poster Award, DLI 2026).

items.title: CLOVES-4603: Benchmarking Classical Texture Features and Fine-Tuned Deep Models for Clove Quality Grading
items.venue: CVPR 2026: 7th Workshop on Vision for Agriculture (CV4A / V4A), Denver, USA
items.tldr: Introduces CLOVES-4603, the first public 4,603-image benchmark for Zanzibar clove grading across four commercial grades, comparing classical texture pipelines (92.94%) against fine-tuned deep architectures (99.67%).

items.title: Unifying Perspectives on Learning Biases: A Data-Centric Intervention for Holistic Fairness, Robustness, and Generalization
items.venue: ICLR 2026 Workshop on Principled Design for Trustworthy AI: Interpretability, Robustness, and Safety across Modalities, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
items.tldr: Introduces Dynamic Data Re-weighting (DDR), a data-centric intervention using adversarial introspection to jointly improve algorithmic fairness, spurious-correlation stability, and out-of-distribution generalization without group labels.

items.title: Culturally Attuned and Resource-Aware Foundation Models for East African Agriculture: A Theoretical Framework and Research Agenda
items.venue: Deep Learning Indaba 2025 Research Track, Proceedings of Machine Learning Research (PMLR Vol. 302, pp. 1–11, 2026)
items.status: Published in PMLR Vol. 302 · Oral & Poster
items.award: Best Poster Award (Publication & Dataset Category), Deep Learning Indaba 2025, Kigali
items.tldr: Defines the four-pillar CARA-FM architecture and nine evaluation indices for East African agricultural foundation models, paired with an operationalized edge-to-cloud benchmark on Zanzibar Cloves and Uganda Cassava.

items.title: Explainable AI for clove quality grading: Benchmarking post hoc XAI and compositional interpretability under domain shift
items.venue: ETRI Journal, Vol. 48, No. 5, pp. 911-923 (Wiley / ETRI)
items.tldr: Evaluates 7 post hoc XAI methods across 8 CNN/ViT models on 4,603 ZSTC clove images, revealing 33.4-82.4% EER attribution fragility and up to 86.5 pp shift drops, whereas a U-Net + ResNet-18 compositional pipeline reaches 99.45% F1 with 100% EER.

items.title: Deep Learning Feasibility Study for Automated Clove Quality Classification Using CNN Architectures on a Novel Zanzibar Dataset
items.venue: 4th EAC STI Conference / AI for East Africa Conference (AI4EAC 2026), Kigali, Rwanda
items.award: Competitive Travel Grant Award, EAC STI 2026, Kigali
items.tldr: Evaluates CNN feasibility on ZSTC-Clove-V1 (5,298 single-clove images across 4 ZSTC grades), finding ResNet-18 reaches 94.46% accuracy (94.33% F1) whereas unresidualized VGG-16 collapses to 31.32% (14.94% F1), motivating explainable pipelines.

items.title: When Synthetic Data Hurts: DCGAN Augmentation Failure Under Extreme Data Scarcity for Cassava Disease Classification in East Africa
items.venue: Data Science Africa (DSA) 2026 Workshop, Makerere University, Kampala, Uganda
items.award: Oral Presentation, Data Science Africa 2026, Kampala
items.tldr: Demonstrates empirically that DCGAN augmentation under extreme data scarcity (25–100 images/class) poisons cassava disease classifiers, dropping macro-F1 by up to 23.2 pp.

items.title: Auditing Representation in Crop Disease Benchmark Datasets Intended for Sub-Saharan African Deployment
items.venue: Data Science Africa (DSA) 2026 Workshop, Makerere University, Kampala, Uganda
items.tldr: Presents a five-dimension representativeness audit of PlantVillage, iCassava 2019, and iBean alongside the six-item AgriAI Bias Card checklist for Sub-Saharan African deployment.

items.title: Few-Shot Transfer Learning for Cassava Leaf Disease Detection Under East African Field Conditions
items.venue: Data Science Africa (DSA) 2026 Workshop, Makerere University, Kampala, Uganda
items.tldr: Evaluates ResNet-50, EfficientNet-B3, MobileNetV3, and ViT-B/16 under linear probing vs. full fine-tuning on 21,397 Ugandan field cassava images at 10–100 shots/class (+28.5 pp gain).

items.title: AI Policy Harmonization in East Africa: Cultural Sustainability in the New Technological Age
items.shortTitle: AI Policy Harmonization in East Africa (TAIS 2026)
items.venue: 3rd Technical AI Safety Conference (TAIS 2026), University of Oxford, UK
items.tldr: Compares Ethiopia, Kenya, and Rwanda AI policies to propose culturally grounded, regionally harmonized East African AI governance rooted in Harambee and Ujamaa values.

items.title: AI Sovereignty in the Global South: Power, Dependency, and Strategic Futures
items.shortTitle: AI Sovereignty in the Global South (AAAI 2026)
items.venue: AAAI 2026 Workshop on Equitable and Sustainable Global AI (EGSAI), Philadelphia, USA
items.tldr: Analyzes compute, talent, and regulatory dependency across the Global South and proposes multipolar South-South AI governance involving the African Union and ASEAN.

items.title: BAFNet: Deep contour-aware features for colorectal polyps segmentation
items.venue: Expert Systems with Applications (Elsevier)
items.tldr: Introduces BAFNet, a boundary-aware feature fusion network with gated contour selection for accurate colorectal polyp segmentation.

items.title: Rectifying the extremely weakened signals for cassava leaf disease detection
items.venue: Computers and Electronics in Agriculture (Elsevier), Vol. 232, 110107
items.tldr: Presents a signal-rectification neural mechanism that recovers attenuated early-stage foliar disease cues in cassava leaf classification.

items.title: Digital Sovereignty or Digital Serfdom? AI Strategies, Geopolitics, and the Quest for an Equitable Global South
items.venue: PAIG Workshop @ EurIPS / NeurIPS 2025 (Private AI Governance)
items.tldr: Introduces a seven-dimensional diagnostic framework across Singapore, Vietnam, Kenya, and Syria to evaluate whether national AI strategies advance digital sovereignty or digital serfdom.

items.title: From Art to Algorithms: Co-Designing AI for Clove Grading with Zanzibar's Indigenous Experts
items.venue: AfriCHI ACM Conference 2025
items.tldr: Partners with Zanzibar clove grading inspectors via participatory HCI co-design alongside a 99.0% segmentation-first deep learning mobile grading workflow.

items.title: A salient feature establishment tactic for cassava disease recognition
items.venue: Artificial Intelligence in Agriculture (Elsevier), Vol. 14, pp. 115–132
items.tldr: Develops a salient feature establishment tactic isolating fine foliar cassava pathology from noisy field backgrounds in Artificial Intelligence in Agriculture (IF 12.4).

items.title: Online chicken carcass volume estimation using depth imaging and 3-D reconstruction
items.venue: Poultry Science (Elsevier), Vol. 103, 104232
items.tldr: Real-time non-contact 3-D surface reconstruction and depth-imaging pipeline for online poultry carcass volume estimation on processing lines.

items.title: MAIANet: Signal modulation in cassava leaf disease classification
items.venue: Computers and Electronics in Agriculture (Elsevier), Vol. 225, 109351
items.tldr: Introduces MAIANet, a signal-modulation deep architecture that amplifies discriminative foliar disease channels in cassava leaf diagnosis (20+ citations).

items.title: Weight and volume estimation of poultry and products based on computer vision systems: a review
items.shortTitle: Poultry Weight & Volume CV Review (Poultry Sci. 2021)
items.venue: Poultry Science (Elsevier), Vol. 100, 101072
items.tldr: Comprehensive survey synthesizing 2D/3D computer vision, depth sensing, and regression pipelines for non-contact poultry weight and volume estimation (144+ citations).

items.title: Weight and volume estimation of single and occluded tomatoes using machine vision
items.venue: International Journal of Food Properties (Taylor & Francis), Vol. 24, pp. 818–832
items.tldr: Extends non-contact machine vision mass and volume estimation from single cherry tomatoes to partially occluded fruit clusters (46+ citations).

items.title: Prediction of precise subsoiling based on analytical method, discrete element simulation and experimental data from soil bin
items.venue: Scientific Reports (Nature Portfolio)
items.tldr: Validates analytical models and discrete element method (DEM) soil-tillage simulations against controlled soil-bin measurements (45+ citations).

items.title: On-line weight estimation of broiler carcass and cuts by a computer vision system
items.shortTitle: Online Broiler Carcass & Cuts Weight CV (Poultry Sci. 2021)
items.venue: Poultry Science (Elsevier), Vol. 100, 101474
items.tldr: Automated vision-based online mass estimation across whole broiler carcasses and commercial retail cuts (36+ citations).

items.title: Detecting the Early Flowering Stage of Tea Chrysanthemum Using the F-YOLO Model
items.venue: Agronomy (MDPI), Vol. 11(5), 834
items.tldr: Introduces F-YOLO for accurate, lightweight detection of early flowering stages in field tea chrysanthemum images.

items.title: Drying process optimization of garlic slices in closed-loop heat pump drying system by Box-Behnken design
items.venue: Journal of Food Processing and Preservation (Wiley)
items.tldr: Applies Box-Behnken response surface optimization to minimize energy consumption and preserve quality during closed-loop heat pump drying of garlic slices.

items.title: A review on computer vision systems in monitoring of poultry: A welfare perspective
items.shortTitle: Computer Vision in Poultry Welfare Review (AIIA 2020)
items.venue: Artificial Intelligence in Agriculture (Elsevier), Vol. 4, pp. 184–208
items.tldr: Landmark survey of computer vision architectures for continuous, non-invasive livestock behavior, health, and welfare monitoring in poultry production (242+ citations).

items.title: Egg volume estimation based on image processing and computer vision
items.shortTitle: Egg Volume Estimation via Computer Vision (JFE 2020)
items.venue: Journal of Food Engineering (Elsevier), Vol. 283, 110041
items.tldr: Non-destructive morphological image processing and infrared-depth modeling for accurate egg volume estimation (87+ citations).

items.title: Wheat Grain Yield Estimation Based on Image Morphological Properties and Wheat Biomass
items.venue: Journal of Sensors, 1571936
items.tldr: Combines morphological image features and wheat biomass measurements for pre-harvest grain yield modeling (36+ citations).

items.title: Separation of partially occluded rice kernels and variety classification based on computer vision
items.venue: International Agricultural Engineering Journal, ISSN 0858-2114
items.tldr: Morphological watershed segmentation and classification for separating touching and occluded rice kernels across grain varieties.

items.title: A machine vision system for early detection and prediction of sick birds: A broiler chicken model
items.shortTitle: Early Sick Broiler Detection via CV (Biosystems Eng. 2019)
items.venue: Biosystems Engineering (Elsevier), Vol. 188, pp. 229–242
items.tldr: Continuous overhead machine vision posture and mobility tracking for early detection and prediction of illness in commercial broiler houses (194+ citations).

items.title: Tomato volume and mass estimation using computer vision and machine learning algorithms: Cherry tomato model
items.venue: Journal of Food Engineering (Elsevier), Vol. 263, pp. 288–298
items.tldr: Depth-imaging and machine learning regression (RBF-SVR) for non-contact cherry tomato volume and mass grading in postharvest lines (178+ citations).

items.title: Production of activated carbon from sludge and herb residue of traditional Chinese medicine industry and its application for methylene blue removal
items.venue: BioResources, Vol. 14(1), pp. 1333–1346
items.tldr: Valorizes pharmaceutical herb residues and sludge into high-surface-area activated carbon adsorbents for wastewater dye remediation (26+ citations).

items.title: Influence of environmental conditions on drying efficiency and heat pump performance in closed and open loop drying of paddy
items.shortTitle: Heat Pump Paddy Drying Efficiency (Drying Tech. 2019)
items.venue: Drying Technology (Taylor & Francis)
items.tldr: Compares thermodynamic efficiency and moisture extraction rates of closed-loop vs. open-loop heat pump paddy dryers across ambient regimes (28+ citations).

items.venue: Computers and Electronics in Agriculture (Elsevier), Vol. 152, pp. 221–232
items.tldr: Automated vision-based inter-birth interval tracking to flag neonatal piglet asphyxia risks in real time during sow farrowing (28+ citations).

items.shortTitle: Farrowing Onset Classification via Sow Activity (2018)

items.tldr: Classifies temporal posture transitions in crated sows to predict impending farrowing onset using overhead sensing.

items.venue: International Journal of Communication Networks and Distributed Systems (Inderscience)
items.tldr: Improves node localization accuracy and clock synchronization across agricultural Wireless Sensor and Actor Networks using virtual-force refinement.
